## 2. Getting Started

### 2.1 Accessing the Application

Open your web browser and navigate to:
```
https://your-deployment-url.example.com
```
Or locally during development:
```
http://localhost:8000
```

### 2.2 Creating Your Account

1. Click **Register** or navigate to `/register`
2. Enter your **email address** (must be unique)
3. Choose a **password** (minimum 8 characters)
4. Click **Create Account**
5. Check your email for a verification link (if email verification is enabled)

> **Note:** If you receive a "email already registered" error, use the login form
> or the **Forgot Password** link.

### 2.3 Logging In

1. Navigate to `/login`
2. Enter your registered **email** and **password**
3. Click **Login**
4. On success, you are redirected to the **Dashboard**

Your session remains active for **[N] hours**. After expiry, you will need to log in again.

### 2.4 Logging Out

Click your **username / avatar** in the top-right corner, then select **Logout**.
Your session is immediately invalidated.

## 4. Core Features

### 4.1 Dashboard

The **Dashboard** is the first screen after login. It shows:
- **Summary cards**: Total resources, recent activity count
- **Recent items**: Your 10 most recently modified resources
- **Quick actions**: Shortcut buttons to create new resources

### 4.2 Viewing Resources

1. Click **Resources** in the sidebar
2. A paginated list of your resources is displayed
3. Use the **search bar** to filter by name
4. Use the **Sort** dropdown to order by `Name`, `Created`, or `Updated`
5. Click any row to open the resource detail view

### 4.3 Creating a Resource

1. From the Resources list, click the **+ New Resource** button
2. Fill in the form:
   - **Name** (required): A descriptive name, max 255 characters
   - **Description** (optional): Free-form text
   - **Additional fields** as required by your deployment
3. Click **Save**
4. On success, you are redirected to the new resource's detail page

> Note: If validation errors appear (highlighted in red), correct the fields
> and resubmit.

### 4.4 Editing a Resource

1. Open the resource detail page (click its name from the list)
2. Click the **Edit** button (pencil icon)
3. Modify the fields as needed
4. Click **Save Changes**

⚠️ **Changes are permanent.** If you need to undo, you must manually revert.

### 4.5 Deleting a Resource

1. Open the resource detail page
2. Click the **Delete** button (trash icon)
3. Confirm the deletion in the modal dialog
4. The resource is removed (soft-deleted — not visible, but recoverable by an Admin)

⚠️ **Warning:** Deleted resources cannot be recovered through the UI.
Contact an Administrator if you need to restore a deleted resource.

## 5. Administrator Functions

> Only users with **Administrator** privileges can access this section.

### 5.1 Accessing the Admin Panel

Navigate to `/admin` or click **Admin** in the sidebar.

### 5.2 Managing Users

| Action | How To |
|--------|--------|
| View all users | Admin → Users → User List |
| Deactivate a user | Click user → Toggle **Active** off → Save |
| Reset a user's password | Click user → **Reset Password** → Enter temporary password |
| Grant admin privileges | Click user → Toggle **Administrator** on → Save |

### 5.3 Viewing Audit Logs

Navigate to **Admin → Audit Log** to see a timestamped record of all admin actions
(user creation, deactivation, resource deletions).

Logs can be filtered by:
- **Date range**
- **Actor** (which admin performed the action)
- **Action type**

## 6. Settings and Configuration

### 6.1 Profile Settings

Navigate to **Settings → Profile** to update:
- Display name
- Email address (requires password confirmation)

### 6.2 Changing Your Password

1. Go to **Settings → Security**
2. Enter your **current password**
3. Enter and confirm your **new password** (min 8 characters)
4. Click **Update Password**

### 6.3 Notification Preferences

Navigate to **Settings → Notifications** to configure:
- Email notifications on resource activity
- Digest frequency (immediate / daily / weekly)

## 7. API Quick Reference (for power users)

The application exposes a RESTful API for programmatic access.
See the **API Documentation** for the full reference.

**Base URL:** `https://your-domain.example.com/api/v1`

**Authenticate:**
```bash
curl -X POST https://your-domain.example.com/auth/login \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"email": "you@example.com", "password": "yourpassword"}'
# Returns: {"access_token": "eyJ...", "token_type": "Bearer"}
```

**List resources:**
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJ..." \
  https://your-domain.example.com/api/v1/resources
```

**Create a resource:**
```bash
curl -X POST https://your-domain.example.com/api/v1/resources \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJ..." \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name": "My Resource"}'
```

## 8. Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?**  
A: On the login page, click **Forgot Password**, enter your email address, and follow
the link in the email you receive.

**Q: Can I export my data?**  
A: Yes. Navigate to **Settings → Data Export** and click **Export as CSV** or **Export as JSON**.

**Q: Why can't I delete a resource?**  
A: You can only delete resources that you own. If you need to delete a resource owned
by another user, ask an Administrator.

**Q: My session keeps expiring. Can I extend it?**  
A: Sessions last [N] hours. For API integrations, use the refresh token endpoint.
Contact your Administrator to adjust the session duration.

**Q: The application is slow. What should I do?**  
A: Try refreshing the page. If the problem persists, report it to your Administrator
(see Section 11: Support).

## 9. Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Likely Cause | Solution |
|---------|-------------|----------|
| Cannot log in — `401 Unauthorized` | Wrong password or email | Use Forgot Password |
| Page not loading | Server offline or network issue | Check with admin; try again |
| `403 Forbidden` on admin pages | No admin privileges | Contact your administrator |
| Changes not saving | Validation errors | Check red-highlighted fields |
| File upload fails | File too large or wrong type | Max size: [X] MB; allowed types: [Y] |
| Blank/white screen | Browser cache issue | Hard refresh: `Ctrl+Shift+R` |
